coverageClaimFromDryadRecord: 446 Bos taurus finishing steers across five independent experiments; the file README describes project, animal, breed, ADG, shrunk mid-body weight, DMI, nutrient intake, diet composition, and gas measurements.
decision: Public bytes are now retrieved and checksum-verified through the unauthenticated version ZIP endpoint. A local source audit and fixed-default engine DMI component check are archived. Keep the result restricted to finishing/feedlot DMI; it does not validate the approved pasture case or full engine.
limits: The source is a feedlot finishing dataset and cannot validate the approved USDA/CPER pasture case.
The record describes an independent evaluation of enteric methane equations, not validation of Agroville.
The direct API file-download endpoint requires bearer auth and the direct file stream returned 403; the public version ZIP endpoint worked and the downloaded bytes match the Dryad file digests.
